title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles #24
desc: Witness the epic finale of "The City That Never Dies" as the city…dies?! Leo, Donnie, and Master Splinter journey through all the lands of all the dead to revive the Tree of Fates and send the undead back to where they belong. Will they be able to complete their quest before General Eight Thunders and his undead army take over New York?!
